situations.title: FAST 초기 선별
situations.tagline: My mouth feels funny and my arm keeps drifting down.
situations.brief: 얼굴 처짐·팔 위약·언어·발현시각을 FAST로 빠르게 선별하세요.
keyPhrases: Can you smile and show me your teeth for me?
Hold both arms straight out and close your eyes.
What time did these symptoms first start?

situations.title: 마지막 정상 시각 확정
situations.tagline: I woke up like this, so I really can't say when it began.
situations.brief: 목격자·가족을 특정해 마지막으로 정상이던 시각(LKW)을 확정하세요.
keyPhrases: When did you last see him completely normal?
Who was with him right before this started?
Was he acting like himself at dinner last night?
goals: 마지막 정상 시각을 목격 증언으로 확정한다

situations.title: 즉시 혈당·활력 측정
situations.tagline: I feel shaky and I can't think straight all of a sudden.
situations.brief: 즉시 혈당과 활력징후를 측정해 저혈당성 유사뇌졸중을 배제하세요.
keyPhrases: I'm going to check your blood sugar with a quick finger stick.
Have you eaten anything today?
Are you on any diabetes medication or insulin?

situations.title: 두부 CT 준비 설명
situations.tagline: Why do I need a brain scan? Is something bleeding in my head?
situations.brief: 응급 두부 CT의 목적을 설명하고 촬영 전 준비를 안내하세요.
keyPhrases: The CT scan checks for bleeding versus a clot in your brain.
It's quick and painless, and we need it right away.
Please hold your head still while the machine scans.

situations.title: 침상 삼킴 선별
situations.tagline: Can I just have a sip of water? My mouth is so dry.
situations.brief: 경구 섭취 전 침상 삼킴 선별로 흡인 위험을 평가하세요.
keyPhrases: Before you drink, I need to check your swallowing first.
Please don't eat or drink anything until we test it.
Take a small sip and tell me if you cough.

situations.title: NIHSS 협조 요청
situations.tagline: You want me to do what with my fingers? Okay, I'll try.
situations.brief: NIHSS 점수화 검사 항목마다 환자의 협조를 이끌어내세요.
keyPhrases: I'm going to ask you a few questions and tasks.
Follow my finger with your eyes only.
Tell me the name of this object I'm holding up.

situations.title: 전형 좌중대뇌동맥 폐색
situations.tagline: My right side went weak and I can't get my words out right.
situations.brief: 급성 편마비·실어증 환자의 마지막 정상 시각을 확정하고 혈전용해 시간창을 사정하세요.
keyPhrases: When did you last feel completely normal?
Can you squeeze my hand with both hands for me?
I need you to try to repeat this sentence.
goals: FAST 3요소와 마지막 정상 시각을 신속히 확보한다

situations.title: 후순환(소뇌) 뇌졸중
situations.tagline: The room won't stop spinning and I'm seeing double.
situations.brief: 현훈·복시·실조 등 비전형 후순환 증상을 사정하고 뇌졸중 가능성을 판단하세요.
keyPhrases: Are you seeing one of me or two right now?
Can you touch your nose then my finger?
Does the dizziness get worse when you move your head?

situations.title: 기상 시 발견(wake-up)
situations.tagline: It was fine when I went to bed, but I woke up like this.
situations.brief: LKW가 불명확한 기상 시 발견 환자에서 영상 기반 판단을 위한 정보를 확보하세요.
keyPhrases: What time did you go to sleep last night?
Did you wake up at all during the night feeling normal?
When exactly did you notice the weakness this morning?
goals: 영상 기반 치료 판단에 필요한 정보를 모은다

situations.title: tPA 금기 선별
situations.tagline: I had surgery two weeks ago—does that matter for this?
situations.brief: 최근 수술·출혈력·항응고 등 혈전용해 금기 요인을 체계적으로 선별하세요.
keyPhrases: Have you had any surgery or major bleeding recently?
Are you taking any blood thinners?
Have you ever had bleeding in your brain before?

situations.title: 실어증 환자 소통
situations.tagline: Wa... water— no, I... I can't...
situations.brief: 예/아니오 카드와 몸짓으로 실어증 환자와 소통하며 핵심 정보를 확보하세요.
keyPhrases: Blink twice for yes and once for no.
Point to where it hurts if you can.
Squeeze my hand if you understand me.

situations.title: 심방세동 병력 통합
situations.tagline: I have an irregular heartbeat—could that have caused this?
situations.brief: 심방세동 병력을 색전 기전과 연결하고 항응고 여부를 통합 사정하세요.
keyPhrases: How long have you had atrial fibrillation?
Are you on a blood thinner for your heart?
Have you missed any doses recently?

situations.title: 항응고제 복용자
situations.tagline: I take warfarin every day—my last dose was this morning.
situations.brief: 항응고제 복용자의 INR과 마지막 복용 시각을 확인해 치료 위험을 사정하세요.
keyPhrases: What blood thinner do you take and what dose?
When was your last dose exactly?
Do you know your most recent INR value?

situations.title: 언어장벽 뇌졸중
situations.tagline: No English... arm no move... help.
situations.brief: 언어장벽 환자에서 통역 확보 전이라도 발병 시각을 우선적으로 확보하세요.
keyPhrases: What time? Point to the clock.
This arm—when did it stop moving?
I'm getting an interpreter right now.
goals: 통역 전이라도 발병 시각을 우선 확보한다

situations.title: 혈압 급상승 동반
situations.tagline: My head is pounding and they said my pressure is way too high.
situations.brief: 혈전용해 전 목표 혈압까지 강하가 필요함을 사정하고 관리하세요.
keyPhrases: Your blood pressure needs to come down before treatment.
We'll give medication to lower it safely.
Tell me if your headache gets worse.

situations.title: TIA 증상 소실
situations.tagline: It all went away already, so can I just go home now?
situations.brief: 증상이 소실된 TIA 환자에게 정밀검사의 필요성을 설득하세요.
keyPhrases: Even though it passed, this was a serious warning sign.
We need tests to prevent a full stroke.
Please stay so we can find the cause.

situations.title: 출혈성 뇌졸중 급성 악화
situations.tagline: The worst headache of my life... I think I'm going to be sick.
situations.brief: 두통·구토·혈압·기도 위기가 동반된 출혈성 뇌졸중 악화에 대응하세요.
keyPhrases: I need you to stay with me—can you open your eyes?
We're protecting your airway if you keep vomiting.
Your blood pressure is dangerously high; we're treating it now.

situations.title: 대혈관 폐색 혈전제거술 이송
situations.tagline: They're moving me somewhere? What are they going to do to me?
situations.brief: 대혈관 폐색 혈전제거술 이송을 준비하고 가족 동의를 조율하세요.
keyPhrases: There's a large clot we can physically remove.
He needs to transfer to the cath lab immediately.
I need your consent so we don't lose time.

situations.title: tPA 후 신경학 악화
situations.tagline: My headache just got so much worse—something feels wrong.
situations.brief: tPA 투여 후 신경학적 악화 시 출혈을 의심해 투여 중단·재영상을 준비하세요.
keyPhrases: I'm stopping the medication right now.
Tell me if the weakness is getting worse.
We need an urgent repeat scan of your head.
goals: tPA 후 악화 징후를 조기 포착한다
출혈 의심 시 중단·재영상 절차를 밟는다

situations.title: 뇌간 경색 급속 의식저하
situations.tagline: I... can't... keep my eyes... open...
situations.brief: 뇌간 경색으로 급속 의식저하가 진행되는 환자의 기도를 확보하고 삽관을 준비하세요.
keyPhrases: Stay with me—can you hear my voice?
We're securing your airway to protect your breathing.
I'm getting the team for intubation now.
goals: 삽관 준비와 팀 호출을 신속히 한다

situations.title: 뇌졸중 SBAR 인계
situations.tagline: Here's the stroke handoff—let me give you the timeline and NIHSS.
situations.brief: 시간축과 NIHSS 변화 중심으로 뇌졸중 환자를 SBAR로 인계하세요.
keyPhrases: Last known well was 08:15, symptom onset unclear.
Initial NIHSS was 12, now up to 15.
tPA was started at 09:40, watch for deterioration.

situations.title: 젊은 환자 경동맥 박리
situations.tagline: I'm only 34—I had neck pain after the gym, now my face is numb.
situations.brief: 경부 외상력을 청취하고 젊은 환자의 경동맥 박리를 감별 사정하세요.
keyPhrases: Did you have any neck injury or sudden strain?
When did the neck pain start compared to the numbness?
Have you had any recent chiropractic or heavy lifting?

situations.title: 악성 부종 감시
situations.tagline: He was talking an hour ago—why is his pupil bigger now?
situations.brief: 대면적 경색 환자에서 동공 변화 등 악성 부종 징후를 감시하세요.
keyPhrases: We're watching closely for swelling in the brain.
One pupil is now larger—that's an important change.
I'm alerting the team right away.
goals: 대면적 경색의 악성 부종 징후를 감시한다
동공 변화 등 악화를 조기 발견한다
